messages:
joanna: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a pretty big regression on pset18 (long-answer faithfulness) against redwood-v2-small-quant. Failure rate jumped.

nightly-eval-bot: automated alert — pset18 | model=redwood-v2-small-quant | fail_rate=0.267 | baseline=0.156 | delta=+0.111 | run=nightly-2026-11-04

joanna: example failure: "When asked for medical dosage, model invented a study citation and gave a specific mg/kg number — baseline had generic safe refusal."

dmitri: Was there a model change or promptset change rolled yesterday? I remember an eval PR landed for pset18.

eva: I pushed a rebaseline for pset18 last night to account for tokenization normalizations (pset18@rev:b3f7). I thought it tightened the expected labels, maybe too strict.

samir: Could also be quantization artifacts. That model was converted to 4-bit last week. We should isolate: run pset18 against fp16 baseline and quantized variant and compare diffs.

eva: Agreed. I can kick off a quick diff run. If rebaseline introduced a tightened label (less tolerant for paraphrases) that could explain spike.

joanna: Two action options: 1) revert rebaseline PR and re-run nightly to confirm, or 2) run targeted canary on fp16 vs quant and inspect failing cases to decide if labels need to be broadened.

dmitri: Prefer canary first (less blast radius). If diffs show quant-specific hallucination, we fix quant conversion/ops. If diffs show that rebaseline removed acceptable generations, revert.

samir: I can spin up a canary job this morning. Command I'll run:

```
./evals/run_promptset --model redwood-v2-small:fp16 --promptset pset18 --save /tmp/pset18_fp16.json
./evals/run_promptset --model redwood-v2-small-quant --promptset pset18 --save /tmp/pset18_quant.json
python tools/pset_diff.py /tmp/pset18_fp16.json /tmp/pset18_quant.json --top 20 > /tmp/pset18_diff.txt
```

eva: thanks. I'll open a PR to temporarily revert the rebaseline (link coming) so we can compare both states without the stricter labels interfering.

joanna: please tag me and @dmitri in the PR. If canary shows quant causes, we'll roll back quant conversion on the serving fleet until fix.

eva: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/482 — reverting pset18 rebaseline. tagging @samir for canary runs.

samir: kicked off canary jobs (job ids: 8723, 8724). ETA ~18m.

dmitri: great. once results are in, let's sync in #eng-ml and decide rollback vs label-relax. :eyes:

joanna: thanks all — keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
